Sticky

The Sticky component has the same effect as the position: sticky property in CSS. When the component is within the screen, it will be arranged according to the normal layout. When the component rolls out of the screen, it will always be fixed at the top of the screen.

Import

Import components in app.json or index.json.

"usingComponents": {
  "maui-sticky": "@macle/maui/sticky/index"
}

Sample Code

1. Basic Usage

Just wrap the content in a Sticky component.

<maui-sticky>
  <maui-button type="primary">Basic usage</maui-button>
</maui-sticky>

2. Offset-top

The offset-top property can be used to set the distance between the component and the top when it is ceiling-mounted.

<maui-sticky offset-top="{{ 50 }}">
  <maui-button type="info">Ceiling distance</maui-button>
</maui-sticky>

3. Specify container

The container of the component can be specified through the container attribute. When the page is scrolled, the component will always remain within the scope of the container. When the component is about to exceed the bottom of the container, it will return to its original position.

<view id="container" style="height: 150px;">
  <maui-sticky container="{{ container }}">
    <maui-button type="warning">Specify container</maui-button>
  </maui-sticky>
</view>

Page({
  data: {
    container: null,
  },

  onReady() {
    this.setData({
      container: () => ma.createSelectorQuery().select('#container'),
    });
  },
});

4. Used nested within scroll-view

Nested use within scroll-view can be achieved through the scroll-top and offset-top properties.

<scroll-view
  bind:scroll="onScroll"
  scroll-y
  id="scroller"
  style="height: 200px;"
>
  <view style="height: 400px; padding-top: 50px;">
    <maui-sticky scroll-top="{{ scrollTop }}" offset-top="{{ offsetTop }}">
      <maui-button type="warning">Nested inside scroll-view</maui-button>
    </maui-sticky>
  </view>
</scroll-view>

Page({
  data: {
    scrollTop: 0,
    offsetTop: 0,
  },

  onScroll(event) {
    ma.createSelectorQuery()
      .select('#scroller')
      .boundingClientRect((res) => {
        this.setData({
          scrollTop: event.detail.scrollTop,
          offsetTop: res.top,
        });
      })
      .exec();
  },
});

API

Props

Parameter Description Type Default Value
offset-top The distance from the top when ceiling is mounted, unit px Number 0
z-index z-index when ceiling Number 99
container A function that returns the NodesRef node corresponding to the container Function -
scroll-top The scroll position of the current scroll area. If it is not null, the monitoring of page scroll events will be disabled. Number -

Events

event name Description Callback parameter
bind:scroll Fires when scrolling { scrollTop: Distance from top position, isFixed: Whether to ceiling }
